faqs.a:
(a)
Any violation of these Arvada/Blunn Reservoir Rules is punishable by a fine not to
               exceed the limits established in
section 1-5
.
(b)
In addition to the penalties provided by this section, any person violating any provision
               of this article shall have his permission, license, or authority to remain at the
               reservoir terminated or revoked and shall be in violation of
section 62-39
(b). Any police officer or park ranger is hereby delegated the authority to terminate
               or revoke the permission, license, or authority of any person to remain at the reservoir
               when such person has violated any provision of the Arvada/Blunn Reservoir Rules.
(Code 1981, § 22-29; Ord. No. 2577, § 2, 12-19-1988)
